name: Cribbage
tagline: Fifteen two, fifteen four… peg your way around the board to 121.
rulesSummary: First to 121 wins — even in the middle of a hand, so every point counts. You score in the pegging and again in the show.
Everyone discards to the crib, an extra hand that scores for the dealer. Then a starter is cut: a jack gives the dealer 2 (his heels).
Pegging: take turns playing a card, keeping a running count up to 31. Make 15 or 31 for 2. Score pairs (2, three of a kind 6, four 12) and runs of 3+ among the last cards played, in any order.
Can't play without passing 31? Say Go. Whoever played last scores 1 (2 for exactly 31), then the count starts again from 0.
The show, from the dealer's left: each hand counts with the starter. Every 15 is 2, plus pairs, runs, a flush (4 in hand, 5 with the starter) and nobs (1 for the jack of the starter's suit).
The dealer counts last, then the crib, which only scores a flush if all five cards match. The deal moves left each hand. A loser short of 91 is skunked; the loser deals the next game.
Muggins (a lobby option): count your own hand and crib. Opponents accept, or call Muggins! with the true total: they take points you missed or overcounted. A wrong call gives you the difference.
Six cards each: put two in the crib.
Five cards each: put one in the crib, and one from the deck joins it. Everyone scores alone.
Partners sit across and score together. Five cards each: put one in the crib.
